prompt:
FANTASY MASTER REFERENCE FIRST: @Video1 is the master reference for the style, mood and world of this whole clip, and it already shows the inside of the fantasy gate (the teal tunnel of floating monitors). Match its render look, materials, colour palette, lighting mood, atmosphere and animation feel on every frame.

EYE RULE (MOST IMPORTANT): the wolf's eye has NO PUPIL. It is ONE solid glowing YELLOW almond shape, filled with one flat uniform yellow light from edge to edge, like a hole of light cut in the black head: no black pupil, no slit pupil, no dark dot, no iris, no ring, no dark line, no eyelid crease or shadow crossing it, no reflection or catchlight, no detail of any kind inside the glow. The eye stays a clean pupil-less yellow glow in EVERY frame, even when the head bobs.

[Generation Goal] 5 seconds, 1 continuous shot, no cuts, 16:9, real-time 24 fps, no slow motion. A tight SIDE-PROFILE tracking shot of the night-shadow wolf's head as it sprints FAST through the inside of the fantasy gate: only the wolf, nobody else.

[References] @Video1: style and world. @Image1: the INSIDE of the fantasy gate, this IS the location: a dark cyan-teal tunnel with many floating glowing white and pale-teal monitors drifting in the air; here it is seen only as a soft, out-of-focus background. @Image2 = THE NIGHT-SHADOW WOLF ONLY: copy its design exactly as in the sheet: the same tall pointed ears, the same long narrow muzzle, the same jagged crest along the back of the head and neck, the same glowing yellow almond eye with NO pupil (a solid flat yellow glow). It is a living NIGHT SHADOW: the whole head is one solid, flat, deep black like ink or a cast shadow; the crest is part of the outline shape only, not furry texture: no fur strands, no fluffy volume, no grey or brown tones, no 3D shading, no highlights inside the silhouette; the edges dissolve slightly into thin plain black smoke.

[Style Lock] ONE single render style: exactly the premium stylized 3D CG look of @Video1 for the world, the light, the depth of field and the film grain. The wolf is the one exception: it keeps the flat solid black night-shadow look of its sheet @Image2, never a 3D-modelled furry animal.

[Head Count] EXACTLY 0 people and 1 night-shadow wolf (@Image2) in this clip. Nobody else exists in this clip: no Mai, no humans, no villains, no other animals.

[No Blending] The wolf (@Image2) is a pure flat black shadow silhouette; it never takes on monitor light, colours or textures from @Image1.

[Composition, LOCKED to the reference frame] Close-up, camera at the wolf's eye level, 85 mm, the wolf seen in strict SIDE PROFILE facing frame RIGHT: its big black head, neck and the start of its shoulder fill the LEFT two-thirds of the frame; the tall pointed ear stands up near the top-centre of the frame; the long narrow muzzle points right and its tip reaches about three-quarters of the way across the frame, in the lower-middle; the single visible eye, a narrow glowing YELLOW almond shape with NO PUPIL (solid flat yellow from edge to edge), sits in the middle of the frame. The right third of the frame and the area above and behind the head show the tunnel background (@Image1): deep dark teal with soft, blurred, glowing white and pale-teal rectangles of floating monitors (bokeh). The wolf's body behind the shoulder runs off the left edge of the frame. Shallow depth of field: the wolf's head sharp-edged, the background very blurred.

[Action & Camera, time-ordered]
Shot 1 (0-5 s), 0 people visible, only the wolf's head in profile: ONE fast lateral tracking move that runs alongside the sprinting wolf at exactly its speed, so the head stays locked in the same place in the frame the whole time. The wolf sprints FAST to the right in a quick urgent gallop: its head pushes forward and bobs up and down with every rapid stride, ears pressed slightly back by the speed, thin wisps of black smoke peeling off the crest and streaming backward to the left; the blurred monitors in the background streak quickly from right to left past the wolf, showing the high speed, some rushing past very close as soft white blurs; the pupil-less glowing eye stays a steady solid yellow almond the whole time. The camera has a light, natural handheld bounce in rhythm with the strides; the horizon stays level.

[Villain Look] Every villain, night-shadow person and shadow creature is plain darkness: a flat, solid NEUTRAL BLACK silhouette like an ordinary cast shadow, no colour tint, no volume, no form shading, no surface detail, no highlights inside the body. NO glow, NO aura, NO halo, NO coloured outline or rim, NO purple, violet or indigo light, haze or particles around or inside them; nothing emanates from them. Any smoke from them is plain black smoke, never glowing.
[Eyes] ALL night-shadow people, villains, shadow creatures and the BOSS have NO PUPILS: each eye is a small flat almond shape filled with ONE uniform glowing colour from edge to edge. NO black pupil, NO dark dot, NO slit, NO iris ring, no eye detail at all inside the glow.

[Acting] The wolf: relentless, predatory, FAST, head low and forward, a tight urgent rhythm with real weight. Classic animation principles: anticipation in each stride, follow-through on the trailing smoke.

[Character Look] The wolf stays a flat pure black silhouette from start to end, like a shape cut from black paper: the inside of the head and neck is ONE flat black with no fur texture, no strands, no sheen, no grey, no highlight on the nose; only the outline is jagged along the crest; only the eye glows.
[Expression] A narrow, menacing, PUPIL-LESS solid yellow eye; the mouth stays closed; no snarling, no teeth.

[Lighting] Dark cyan-teal tunnel light; the floating monitors give soft white-teal glows in the background only; the wolf's head is a flat PURE BLACK silhouette that the light does not model (no rim highlights, never grey); its pupil-less eye is the brightest yellow point of the frame.

[Visual Style] Exactly the style of @Video1 (premium stylized 3D animated feature film, matte materials, fine film grain, slight bloom, shallow depth of field). 16:9, real-time 24 fps.

[Audio] Sound effects and ambience only: rapid heavy shadow footfalls, a rushing whoosh of wind and smoke, fast ghostly panting, a low growl, the deep electric hum of the tunnel with monitors whooshing past. NO music, NO score, NO song, NO singing, NO melody, no dialogue.

[Avoid] a pupil, a black or dark pupil, a slit pupil, a dark dot or line inside the eye, an iris, a catchlight in the eye, a realistic animal eye; fur texture or sheen on the neck, a shiny or white nose tip; any text, letters, numbers, subtitles, timecode, captions, scene labels or logos anywhere; pupils, black pupils, dark dots in the eye, slit pupils, irises, two eyes visible; a frontal or three-quarter view of the wolf; the wolf facing left; the full body of the wolf; teeth, fangs, open mouth, blood; fur, hair strands, fluffy or shaggy coat, furry texture, a dark brown or grey wolf, a 3D-shaded wolf head with light on it, visible muscles; purple, violet or indigo glow or aura; people, Mai, villains, other animals; a slow trot, the wolf stopping; slow motion, freeze frame; cuts or a second shot; a sharp, in-focus background; an outdoor street or sky; mixed art styles; studio or film names.
